title: The Boomers All Grown Up
coreMove: Trace a leadership norm back to the era that rewarded it before treating resistance as attitude.
sourcePressure: Shows how boom-era institutional training becomes adult leadership expectation, making inherited rules feel timeless and personal clashes look like character problems.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Blaming a generation or defending another generation instead of seeing historical training inside institutions.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
